text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 43, June 13, 1936 ]
TRANSFERRING CERTAIN FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES OF THE BUREAU OF SCIENCE TO OTHER
ENTITIES UNDER THE COMMONWEALTH OF THE PHILIPPINES
WHEREAS, by virtue of the provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five, a Government Survey Board
has been created for the purpose of recommending to the President needed reforms in the present organization
of the Government; and
WHEREAS, the said Government Survey Board has recommended the transfer of certain functions, duties,
personnel, appropriations, books, records, equipment, supplies, lands, buildings, and other property of the
Bureau of Science to other entities under the Commonwealth of the Philippines;
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws and in
pursuance of the provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five, it is hereby directed that—
1. The following functions and duties heretofore performed by the Bureau of Science shall be transferred
therefrom to the Government organizations designated herein:
(a) The analysis and inspection of foods and drugs in connection with the enforcement of the Food and Drugs
Act, the Nutrition Laboratory, the Division of Biological Products, and the Alabang Vaccine and Serum
Laboratory, to the School of Hygiene and Public Health of the University of the Philippines;
(b) The Iloilo Biological Research Laboratory and Cebu Biological Research Laboratory, to the Bureau of
(c) The anti-rabic treatment service now being performed by the Bureau of Science, to the Philippine General
(d) The manufacture of tiki-tiki extract, to the College of Pharmacy of the University of the Philippines. This
transfer should be effected as soon as proper arrangements can be conveniently made for the installation of the
tiki-tiki plant in the College of Pharmacy; and
(e) The Home Economics Division, to the Bureau of Plant Industry and Education, as the Budget Commission
may find appropriate.
